message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant Xiao provided a place for Chen to use methamphetamine (甲基苯丙胺) by "烫吸" (probably smoking). This is "容留他人吸毒" (providing a place for others to use drugs). Under Chinese criminal law, that is a crime of "容留他人吸毒罪" (Crime of harboring others to use drugs). The statutory name is "容留他人吸毒". According to correction rule: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "容留他人吸毒". Also note that the defendant is a repeat offender (累犯) and self-surrender (自首) but those are sentencing factors, not separate crimes.

Thus only one crime: "容留他人吸毒". No other crimes like drug trafficking, manufacturing, etc. The facts show only providing place, not possessing or trafficking. So we list single crime.
